items.ex: 찬 음식을 너무 많이 먹지 마세요.

bg-19-01.hint: Please do not go outside alone.
bg-19-01.why: Attach -지 마세요 directly to the verb stem 가-: 가지 마세요.

bg-19-01.q: Write a polite sentence telling someone not to eat late at night, using 밤에 and 먹지 마세요.
bg-19-01.sample: 건강을 위해 밤에 라면을 먹지 마세요.
bg-19-01.why: Attach -지 마세요 directly to 먹- without any stem change.

steps.en: Please do not eat cold food.
If your stomach hurts, please do not eat cold food.

ko: 동생이 감기에 걸려서 기침을 많이 해요.
의사 선생님이 동생에게 차가운 물을 마시지 마세요라고 말씀하셨어요.
그리고 밖에 나가지 마세요, 집에서 푹 쉬세요라고 하셨어요.
en: My younger sibling caught a cold and coughs a lot.
The doctor told my sibling, 'Please do not drink cold water.'
And the doctor said, 'Please do not go outside, and rest well at home.'

bg-19-01.q: What did the doctor tell the younger sibling not to drink?
options: Cold water
Warm tea
Hot soup
bg-19-01.why: The passage says '차가운 물을 마시지 마세요라고 말씀하셨어요' (Told them not to drink cold water).

bg-19-01.q: Where did the doctor tell the sibling to rest?
options: At home
At the playground
At the swimming pool
bg-19-01.why: The passage states '밖에 나가지 마세요, 집에서 푹 쉬세요' (Do not go outside, rest well at home).

items: I can form polite negative requests using -지 마세요
I can attach -지 마세요 directly to verb stems regardless of vowel or batchim

bg-19-02.hint: Please do not open the window.
bg-19-02.why: ㄹ-stem verbs like 열다 keep ㄹ before -지 마세요: 열지 마세요.

bg-19-02.q: Write a polite warning telling someone not to touch a picture with their hands, using 손으로 and 만지지 마세요.
bg-19-02.why: Attach -지 마세요 directly to the stem 만지-: 만지지 마세요.

bg-19-02.hint: Before -지 마세요, ㄹ-stem verbs like 울다 do NOT drop ㄹ!
bg-19-02.why: -지 마세요 attaches directly to the intact stem 울-: 울지 마세요.

steps.en: Please do not cross the road.
Because it is dangerous, please do not cross the road.

ko: 오늘 우리 반 학생들은 역사 박물관에 견학을 갔어요.
안내 선생님이 오래된 물건을 손으로 만지지 마세요라고 주의를 주셨어요.
그리고 전시실 문을 함부로 열지 마세요라고 말씀하셨어요.
en: Today our class students went on a field trip to the history museum.
The guide teacher warned us, 'Please do not touch the old artifacts with your hands.'
And the teacher said, 'Please do not open the exhibition room doors carelessly.'

bg-19-02.q: What did the guide teacher tell the students not to touch?
options: The old artifacts in the museum
Their own backpacks
The school bus seats
bg-19-02.why: The passage says '오래된 물건을 손으로 만지지 마세요라고 주의를 주셨어요'.

bg-19-02.q: What else did the teacher tell the students not to do?
options: Do not open the exhibition room doors carelessly
Do not read the information signs
Do not take notes in a notebook
bg-19-02.why: The passage states '전시실 문을 함부로 열지 마세요라고 말씀하셨어요'.

items: I can keep irregular stems intact before -지 마세요 (듣지 마세요, 울지 마세요, 열지 마세요)
I can understand and give clear warnings using -지 마세요

items.en: you must not talk on the phone
please do not overdo it / overwork

items.ex: 목이 아플 때는 찬물을 마시지 마세요.

bg-19-03.hint: You must not talk on the phone here.
bg-19-03.why: -(으)면 안 돼요 states a strict rule or public prohibition.

bg-19-03.q: Write one sentence stating a rule that you must not park here, using 여기에 and 주차하면 안 돼요.
bg-19-03.sample: 출입구 앞이라서 여기에 주차하면 안 돼요.
bg-19-03.why: Use -(으)면 안 돼요 to state an objective rule or regulation.

bg-19-03.wrong: 친구가 시험 때문에 불안해하니까 너무 걱정하지 말세요라고 위로했어요.
answers: 친구가 시험 때문에 불안해하니까 너무 걱정하지 마세요라고 위로했어요.
친구가 시험 때문에 불안해하니까 너무 걱정하지 마세요라고 위로했어요
bg-19-03.hint: The negative command of 말다 is 마세요 (말세요 is not used): 걱정하지 마세요.
bg-19-03.why: 걱정하지 말세요 is wrong: 말다 drops ㄹ before ㅅ, so it is 걱정하지 마세요.

bg-19-03.h: Polite Advice (-지 마세요) vs Rule Prohibition (-(으)면 안 돼요)

a.d: Politely asks the listener not to do something, or warmly comforts them.
ex: 너무 **걱정하지 마세요**. — Please don't worry too much.
감기 걸렸을 때 찬물을 **마시지 마세요**. — Please don't drink cold water when you have a cold.

b.d: States an objective rule, law, or social regulation ('must not / not allowed').
ex: 도서관에서 **통화하면 안 돼요**. — You must not talk on the phone in the library.
여기에 **주차하면 안 돼요**. — You are not allowed to park here.

bg-19-03.tip: Use -(으)면 안 돼요 to explain general rules and laws; use -지 마세요 for personal advice, requests, and emotional reassurance.

base.en: You must not talk on the phone.

steps.en: You must not talk on the phone in the library.
You must not talk on the phone in a quiet library.

ko: 영화관 안에서는 지켜야 할 예절이 있어요.
영화가 시작되면 휴대폰으로 통화하면 안 돼요.
그리고 앞사람 의자를 발로 차지 마세요.
en: Inside a movie theater, there is etiquette we must follow.
Once the movie starts, you must not talk on the phone.
And please do not kick the seat of the person in front of you.

bg-19-03.q: What rule applies once the movie starts in the theater?
options: You must not talk on your mobile phone
You must stand up and clap
You must open the emergency doors
bg-19-03.why: The passage says '영화가 시작되면 휴대폰으로 통화하면 안 돼요' (Once the movie starts, you must not talk on the phone).

bg-19-03.q: What polite etiquette request is given regarding the person in front of you?
options: Please do not kick their seat
Please ask for their ticket
Please borrow their glasses
bg-19-03.why: The passage states '앞사람 의자를 발로 차지 마세요' (Please do not kick the seat in front of you).

items: I can distinguish between personal advice (-지 마세요) and strict rules (-(으)면 안 돼요)
I can use warm reassurance expressions like 걱정하지 마세요 and 무리하지 마세요

items.en: please do not make noise / chat loudly

items.ex: 면접 볼 때 너무 긴장하지 마세요.

bg-19-04.hint: Please do not run in the hallway.
bg-19-04.why: 뛰다 attaches -지 마세요 for a public safety notice.

bg-19-04.q: Write a warm sentence comforting a nervous friend before an exam, using 너무 and 긴장하지 마세요.
bg-19-04.why: Use 긴장하지 마세요 to warmly reassure someone who feels anxious.

bg-19-04.wrong: 독서실 안에서는 큰 소리로 떠드지 마세요.
answers: 독서실 안에서는 큰 소리로 떠들지 마세요.
독서실 안에서는 큰 소리로 떠들지 마세요
bg-19-04.hint: 떠들다 is a ㄹ-stem verb, and ㄹ does NOT drop before -지 마세요!
bg-19-04.why: Keep the ㄹ intact before -지 마세요: 떠들지 마세요.

steps.en: Please do not run on the platform.
Please do not run on the subway platform.

ko: 지하철역 에스컬레이터 옆에 안전 안내문이 붙어 있어요.
안내문에는 손잡이를 놓지 마세요, 그리고 걷거나 뛰지 마세요라고 적혀 있어요.
안전 규칙을 지키면 모두가 편안하게 지하철을 이용할 수 있어요.
en: A safety notice is posted next to the subway station escalator.
On the notice, it is written: 'Please do not let go of the handrail, and please do not walk or run.'
If everyone follows the safety rules, we can all use the subway comfortably.

bg-19-04.q: What two warnings are written on the escalator safety notice?
options: Do not let go of the handrail, and do not walk or run
Do not bring bags, and do not wear hats
Do not read books, and do not drink water
bg-19-04.why: The passage says '손잡이를 놓지 마세요, 그리고 걷거나 뛰지 마세요라고 적혀 있어요'.

bg-19-04.q: What happens if everyone follows the safety rules?
options: Everyone can use the subway comfortably
The subway ticket becomes free
The train arrives ten minutes early
bg-19-04.why: The passage states '안전 규칙을 지키면 모두가 편안하게 지하철을 이용할 수 있어요'.

items: I can read and understand common public prohibition signs in Korea
I can offer warm encouragement like 긴장하지 마세요 and 부담 갖지 마세요
